title: Unit – 1 : Session – 8 : SLO – 1  |  Kernel Data Structures — Symbol Code Puzzle
sections: Decoding the symbols with the key at the bottom of the page reveals:
"KERNEL DATA STRUCTURES KEEP TRACK OF PROCESSES, MEMORY, FILES AND DEVICES."
II. What Are Kernel Data Structures?
PROCESS LIST / PCB TABLE — one Process Control Block per process (state, registers, PC).
READY QUEUE and WAIT (device) QUEUES — linked lists of process descriptors used by schedulers.
MEMORY MAPS / PAGE TABLES — track free and allocated frames and address translation.
OPEN FILE TABLE and INODE structures — track files opened by processes.
DEVICE TABLE and I/O request queues — track devices and pending operations.
